items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: I remember when we were playing with Big Eye Louis in New Orleans.

ctx.x: Well it's funny though, you know people here, you talk about eating rabbit pie or anything, they, they think it's a joke. And I always used to like rabbit.
Yes. I did too. I loved rabbit. I sure did boy because I remember when we were playing with Big Eye Louis in New Orleans. And they were great cooks, all of the guys in the band, and huntsmen.
